name: colab-bridge
description: Connect Antigravity to Google Colab GPUs/TPUs via a local Stdio MCP server wrapping google-colab-cli for zero-prompt session provisioning, Python/shell execution, file sync, and async long-running jobs.
suggestedPrompts: Check Google Colab bridge health, active sessions, and compute-unit balance
Provision a Colab T4 GPU session, verify nvidia-smi, and stop it cleanly when done
Upload a packed Blender scene to Colab and render a Cycles GPU frame asynchronously
